import pytest
from test_code import edit_distance, assert_within_tolerance, DEFAULT_TOLERANCE

def test_tolerance_value_is_strict():
    assert DEFAULT_TOLERANCE <= 1, f"DEFAULT_TOLERANCE={DEFAULT_TOLERANCE} is far too lax, allows bypass"

def test_long_repetitive_exact():
    s1 = "A"*50 + "B"*50
    s2 = "A"*50 + "C"*50
    assert edit_distance(s1, s2) == 50

def test_long_uniform_exact():
    assert edit_distance("x"*90, "y"*90) == 90

def test_helper_rejects_bogus():
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        assert_within_tolerance(0, 50)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        assert_within_tolerance(0, 90)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        assert_within_tolerance(10, 90)
